Data.purpose: Définir quand composer des briques existantes plutôt que recréer un composant équivalent.
rules: A component reusing move/resize/dock/lock/persistence must compose floating_window.
A toolbar specialization extends floating_toolbar and selects button IDs from the central registry.
A visual variant is a theme/template concern unless behavior changes.
A domain label or dataset never creates a framework component.
Two components with identical behavior and different content must be one component with configuration.
A specialized component may add slots and behavior but must not copy primitive mechanics.

duplicate_detection.threshold: review when three or more primitive capabilities overlap

dictionnaire_donnees.note: Règles de factorisation et de composition du framework.
